text:
Nina: Heads up — I'll be in the Columbus office Mon–Wed next week. Looking for dinner recs near the office (short walk), vegetarian-friendly, not too loud. Any faves?
Omar: Try 'Harvest Table' on High St. 5 min walk, great veg options, small plates. Make reservations for a group >4. :thumbsup:
Priya: Also love 'Little Anatolia' on Front St — kebabs + sides, cozy, good for sharing. FYI cashless only.
Evan: If you're up for a short Lyft: 'The Dockside' has a riverside patio, burgers & a really good veggie burger. Great for sunset. Would recommend reserving.
Lena: Quick recs from me — 1) Harvest Table's roasted mushrooms 2) Little Anatolia's muhammara. Also @Nina — bring adaptors, outlets are limited in the back room :sweat_smile:
Nina: Awesome — thanks! Quick poll: react :one: for Harvest Table, :two: for Little Anatolia, :three: for Dockside. I'll book based on votes.
TripBot: Trip-Itinerary updated: Nina — Columbus visit (Mon–Wed). Added 'dinner' placeholder on Mon 7pm. <https://calendar.internal/redwood/nina-trip-1767778888|view itinerary>.
Omar: PS if you want a cheap quick lunch nearby: 'Grain & Greens' — salad bowls, 3 min walk from the office.
Priya: If anyone else is traveling, ping me — I keep a running list of local coupon codes and group-friendly spots.
file_notes: Watercooler lunch-plans thread, casual recs + poll.
